title: HTM predictive-state depolarizing bias into the basket-cell first-spike race
source: docs/research/path-decision-synthesis.md @ e16d22c, section Probe P-B + section 2.3 constants
frozen_before: implementation (this file committed before src/humanbrain/race_bias.py exists)

lane.substrate: humanbrain.cortex.DendriticCortex (Allen GLIF3 fitted parameters, compiled unit-response first-spike race under basket inhibition)
lane.mechanism_verbatim: small sustained somatic bias (or threshold offset), proportional to matched-segment count, on cells whose distal branch matched the recent winner history, consumed by the existing basket-cell first-spike race

segment_mapping.note: lane-native instantiation of HTM constants; principles/constants adopted, algorithmic simulator NOT ported (synthesis 2.3 avoid row)
segment_mapping.segment: one grown dendritic branch (phase-ordered presynaptic winner-history key -> postsynaptic token cell)
segment_mapping.recent_winner_history: the actual recent race-winner token sequence (teacher-forced context at eval; ground-truth replay stream during growth)
segment_mapping.connected_contacts: min(contact_cap, floor(branch_strength)); each co-occurrence potentiates one contact (growth increment 1.0)
segment_mapping.match_predicate: connected_contacts >= theta_connected with theta_connected = 13 (task brief: theta ~= 13 connected of ~20 grown to start)

lane.bias_form: somatic CURRENT addition chosen (not threshold offset); voltage response is linear in current pre-first-spike so the two are interchangeable up to scaling; addition consumes the existing race unchanged

n_semantics.definition: N = pyramidal token-cell budget of the cortical sheet: word-type cells (TRAIN-stream frequency rank, ties lexicographic) plus one reserved UNK cell
n_semantics.rationale: the recurrent-circuit legs (N=96/N=1024 reservoir cells, race-pivot gate + APICAL-AND) map onto this lane as the raced pyramidal population; the sheet must also encode every prompt word, hence the UNK cell
n_semantics.deviation_note: recorded openly: prior legs sized a latent reservoir; this lane sizes the token-cell sheet itself. Restriction can only LOWER our ceiling (unreachable VAL targets auto-miss), so passing gates under restriction is conservative.

arms.role: parity anchor; bit-identical to the incumbent race required
CONTROL; identical per-race bias-magnitude multiset assigned to uniformly sampled active cells, Generator(PCG64(control_seed)) advanced exactly once per race call

proportional bias + predictedSegmentDecrement analog: during TRAIN replay only, every theta-connected matching segment whose target lost the race loses 0.04 x increment strength per converged-but-lost event (floor 0)
DIAGNOSTIC only (the '-' side of the +/- spec): losers gain 0.04 x increment instead; never used for the pass/fail verdict

scoring.readout: race-resolved only: the race winner IS the prediction; NO offline heads (logistic/MLP/probe) anywhere
scoring.protocol: teacher-forced span eval mirroring tools/qa_baselines.answer_span_eval verbatim: prompt = words(serialized_prompt_answer.split('\nA:')[0]) with words = regex [a-z0-9']+ over casefolded text; per answer-word target: predict from context via ONE race, score pred == target, append TARGET to context
scoring.val_denominator_check: VAL predictions must equal 639 exactly; abort otherwise
scoring.splits: TRAIN-self (train-manifest items, model grown on their books) vs VAL held-out books reported at EVERY stage (38.3%-to-0% early-warning)
scoring.instrumentation_free: per-race winning spike time and biased-winner fraction logged per arm (burst/anomaly telemetry per synthesis 2.1)

fixture_N96_stop_on_failure: flag-off bit-parity: race records AND grown branch state hash byte-identical between the incumbent race path and the flag-off probe path
double-run determinism: identical config/seed reproduces byte-identical result records (modulo wall clock)
every registered arm executes and emits finite telemetry
cohort_N1024_pass: held-out-book (VAL) span accuracy of the best registered primary arm STRICTLY ABOVE the shuffled-bias control (paired McNemar discordant test reported)
AND strictly above frozen unigram 4.538% and majority-prior 4.069%
TRAIN-self vs VAL split shows transfer, not self-store memorization
gates.falsifier: depolarized arm <= shuffled-control arm, or movement confined to TRAIN books (the 38.3%-to-0% signature) => predictive-state-as-race-head-start joins the dead list
gates.stop_rules: fixture failure aborts the cohort permanently; no re-seeding, re-tuning, or re-execution after the first token of any leg; the cohort is spent exactly once

owned_files: minimal opt-in hook inside src/humanbrain/cortex.py (default-off, shared with sibling P-A agent only via clean diffs)
